bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
src=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/create-videobot
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
base=c22ffc587781874ef463c2d912774376fb4e55a8
head=807cea978e88b04cffbc27eb4497183671ac79cf
root=/home/gace/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/native-sticker-c8c50d420c0b9b5d447a1fc87ef3d9e1ec7aceed
release="$root/.releases/$head/video-threeway-merge"
new=create-videobot:video-threeway-807cea97-tested
old=create-videobot:before-video-threeway-807cea97
test -d "$src/.git" && test -f "$root/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml" || exit 61
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}' 2>/dev/null)" = true || exit 62
test "$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=gace-createvdobot --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll -q | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 63
test "$(docker image inspect create-videobot:local-poll --format '{{.Id}}')" = "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}')" || exit 64
test ! -e "$release" && test -z "$(docker images -q "$new")" || exit 65
git -C "$src" fetch --no-tags origin feat/assistant-ai-and-sales-core >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 66
test "$(git -C "$src" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$head" || exit 67
test "$(git -C "$src" merge-base "$base" "$head")" = "$base" || exit 68
test "$(df -Pm "$root" | tail -n 1 | awk '{print $4}')" -gt 750 || exit 69
mkdir -p "$release/ours/src/telegram" "$release/base/src/telegram" "$release/theirs/src/telegram" "$release/src/telegram" "$release/test"
mask=0; bit=1
for p in src/telegram/creatorWizard.mjs src/telegram/creatorUi.mjs src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs src/telegram/salesPanel.mjs;do
 docker cp "$cid:/opt/videobot/$p" "$release/ours/$p" || exit 70
 orig="$(docker exec "$cid" sha256sum "/opt/videobot/$p" | awk '{print $1}')" || exit 71
 test "$(sha256sum "$release/ours/$p" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$orig" || exit 72
 git -C "$src" show "$base:$p" > "$release/base/$p" || exit 73
 git -C "$src" show "$head:$p" > "$release/theirs/$p" || exit 74
 if git merge-file -p "$release/ours/$p" "$release/base/$p" "$release/theirs/$p" > "$release/$p";then
   echo "VIDEO_THREEWAY_MERGE_$bit=PASS"
 else
   code=$?
   test "$code" = 1 || exit 75
   echo "VIDEO_THREEWAY_MERGE_$bit=CONFLICT"
   mask=$((mask+bit))
 fi
 bit=$((bit*2))
done
if test "$mask" -ne 0;then echo "VIDEO_THREEWAY_CONFLICT_MASK=$mask";exit $((90+mask));fi
for p in test/creatorWizard.test.mjs test/creatorUi.test.mjs test/creatorBot.test.mjs test/creatorSourceIntegration.test.mjs test/paidListingPublisher.test.mjs test/salesPanel.test.mjs test/pgUnifiedStarsSales.test.mjs;do
 git -C "$src" show "$head:$p" > "$release/$p" || exit 76
 test -s "$release/$p" || exit 77
done
docker tag create-videobot:local-poll "$old" || exit 78
{ echo "FROM $old";echo 'USER root';for p in src/telegram/creatorWizard.mjs src/telegram/creatorUi.mjs src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs src/telegram/salesPanel.mjs test/creatorWizard.test.mjs test/creatorUi.test.mjs test/creatorBot.test.mjs test/creatorSourceIntegration.test.mjs test/paidListingPublisher.test.mjs test/salesPanel.test.mjs test/pgUnifiedStarsSales.test.mjs;do echo "COPY --chown=node:node $p /opt/videobot/$p";done;echo 'USER node';} > "$release/Dockerfile"
docker build --network none --pull=false -t "$new" "$release" >/dev/null || exit 79
for p in src/telegram/creatorWizard.mjs src/telegram/creatorUi.mjs src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs src/telegram/salesPanel.mjs;do
 docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node "$new" --check "/opt/videobot/$p" || exit 80
done
if ! docker run --rm --network none -w /opt/videobot --entrypoint node "$new" --test test/creatorWizard.test.mjs test/creatorUi.test.mjs test/creatorBot.test.mjs test/creatorSourceIntegration.test.mjs test/paidListingPublisher.test.mjs test/salesPanel.test.mjs test/pgUnifiedStarsSales.test.mjs > "$release/test-results.log" 2>&1;then
 echo VIDEO_THREEWAY_REGRESSION_TEST=FAIL
 grep -E '^not ok |^# pass |^# fail ' "$release/test-results.log" | head -n 25 || true
 exit 81
fi
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 82
test "$(docker image inspect create-videobot:local-poll --format '{{.Id}}')" = "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}')" || exit 83
echo VIDEO_THREEWAY_COMPAT_TEST=PASS
echo VIDEO_THREEWAY_LIVE_MUTATION=NO
